method: News coverage and campaign-trail reporting scored for narrative direction (favorite gaining/losing ground) and intensity (fundraising, endorsements, gaffes, message discipline). This is NOT a poll - it's a bounded nudge applied only to toss-up/lean seats, capped at +/-0.08 win probability, and always shown separately from the polling-based number.

assessments.rationale: Brown leads in most recent public polling (Fox +8 in Aug, unchanged since June; Wedgewood +4) and cost-of-living/inflation framing dominates coverage in a way that favors him per Fox's own poll analysis. But RealClearPolling's average is much tighter (Brown 47.8 to Husted 47.2) and some individual polls (NYT/Siena, Quantus) show Husted ahead - genuinely a toss-up in aggregate, with narrative momentum tilted slightly Brown.

note: The two races above were live-assessed as a working demonstration of the method. The remaining toss-up/lean races need the same treatment - that's exactly the daily job the scheduled agent below performs.
